newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Commission's final 1996 briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Commission's final 1996 briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Jean-Christophe Filori said the Commission will be closed on Tuesday and the next midday briefing will be on Friday January 3, 1997. Filori will be available to journalists during the Christmas holidays.
The Commission released the following documents:
- 96/1239: Infringement procedures: obstacles to freedom to provide services and freedom of establishment - Spain, Italy, Belgium, Germany.
- IP 96/1245: European Commission/ World Bank to host preparatory donors meeting for Bosnia and Herzegovina.
- Statement by External Trade Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan on designation of members of Hong Kong's future provisional Legislative Council.
- Christmas letter from Emma Bonino, European Commissioner for humanitarian aid to U.N. Secretary General Kofi Annan.
